scope: Current task-level factual package for the Morytania Achievement Diary. It proposes future normalized actions and graph structure only; it changes no production data, strategy scores, or route order.

included: quest, skill, item, location, and encounter gates

global_rules.entry_gate: Priest in Peril completion is required for all Morytania tasks because it grants Morytania access.
global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
global_rules.tier_claim: A tier claim requires every task in that tier and all preceding tier claims.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy a skill requirement unless a task explicitly says otherwise.
global_rules.transition_rule: A successful action adds only its durable Morytania task milestone. It never infers variable drops, combat victory, crop growth, minigame participation, cooldown availability, or item ownership beyond an explicitly modeled deterministic transformation.

normalization_proposal.rule: Each task becomes one action awarding only its durable milestone. Claim actions require the complete tier and prior claim, award legs capability plus lamp entitlement and fixed utility. Daily exchanges, teleports, charged bonecrusher state, farming patch state, minigame points, XP, Barrows loot, and combat outcomes remain in their dedicated models or observed state.
graph_edges: Priest in Peril, every listed quest, stated skill gate, required item, and existing access node -> task action (requires)
all tier task milestones plus prior claimed tier -> tier claim action (requires)
tier claim action -> claimed-tier milestone, legs capability, lamp entitlement, and stated utility (produces)
existing POH Kharyrll, Ectophial, farming, Barrows, Slayer, and transport nodes remain dependencies; this package creates no duplicate capability nodes
normalization_proposal.theatre_of_blood_boundary: Theatre of Blood is relevant Morytania endgame content but is neither a diary task nor a prerequisite to any listed task. Do not add it as an inferred combat or route dependency from this package.

special_boundaries_covered: Slayer Tower task and XP effects

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Canifis Slayer Master wording
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The diary page records that While Guthix Sleeps (10 July 2024) replaced the historical Mazchna-specific task wording with the Slayer Master in Canifis. Older guides naming only Mazchna are stale.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Combat, Barrows, and Theatre of Blood
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Nominal levels, gear, quest access, and Slayer levels never establish that the account can win a combat encounter, clear Barrows, own a complete Barrows set, or complete Theatre of Blood. Each diary combat task is player-confirmed; Theatre of Blood has no diary dependency here.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Farming and minigames
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Harmony/Canifis crop growth, disease, yield, Temple Trek events, Trouble Brewing participation, and shade reward rolls require their own activity-state models and are not generated by task completion.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Ectofuntus and rewards
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Ectofuntus XP/tokens, Robin daily availability, legs teleport counters, Bonecrusher charges, and Barrows rune quantity are concrete mechanics but variable/cooldown/charged state; claims expose capabilities rather than fabricate current counts.
